_comment: Repo allowlist. Key = the name delegate_task uses. Either 'path' (an existing local clone) or 'url' (https/ssh git URL on a host in daemon.json allowed_clone_hosts; the daemon clones it into <data_dir>/repos/<name>). allowed_test_commands are anchored regexes; keep them narrow. Prefer `sudo workhorse add-repo` over editing by hand.

hello-world.description: Tiny example repo created by the installer for smoke tests (workhorse hello). Safe to remove.
